question:
Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Find the letter opposite of y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70663c015c90bff0192d2dd9b675c6bd423650362f4df6e8e08802f45b060c47.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As x is common on both the dice, it is clear that y, z, m, and n are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. p will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d96eedac3854e8dd8dc78e6781368ad362bd62623de302af290e4395d3dbc28.png] 

Opposite pairs:

y → m

z → n

x → p

So, the opposite side of "y" will be side "m".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
